newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$3 bln in NCDs on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$3 bln in NCDs on Monday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Monday it would issue T$3 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposits later in the day.
Bids will close at 3.00 pm (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.
The central bank's recent non-stop NCD issuance was seen widely in the market as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts say has been fuelling the sizzling stock market rally.
The central bank however denied this was the case, saying the bank was acting purely in response to the liquidity situation.
The stock index had fallen for five straight sessions, ending down 24.28 points or 0.29 percent at 8,302.25 on Saturday.
